_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 3: the player ship, labyrinth part and the dying ship ($8F13-$9120). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: Ship walking tile base: 8 facings x 4 poses
Ship walking palette (flip): 8 facings x 4 poses
THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): hit spin?
regions.description: `LDY $32`; `$0578` bits 7 and 6 both set (a hit, still flashing) take the spin; otherwise `$8F85`.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): hit spin: phase
regions.description: `LDA #$80 / LDY #$08 / JSR $C0A5`: eight phases, a new one every 2 frames.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): hit spin: tile base
regions.description: `$06C8` := `$8F75[phase]` (`00 40 28 58 10 58 28 40`): the ship turns through its facings.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): hit spin: palette
THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): hit spin: picture
regions.description: Metasprite `$50`; `RTS`.

regions.name: Ship hit-spin tile base (labyrinth)
Ship hit-spin palette (labyrinth)
THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): walking picture: standing?
regions.description: Cell 4 (no direction) keeps the pose; otherwise the walk phase advances (below).

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): walking picture: the phase
regions.description: `LDA #$20 / LDY #$04 / JSR $C0A5`: four poses, a new one every 8 frames (also called after a hit to restore the pose).

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): walking picture: the tile base
regions.description: Y := 2 x the facing + the pose; `$06C8` := `$8F13[Y]`. **The facing is always even, so the 32 entries are 8 groups of 4 poses: right `20 28 30 28`, down-right `38 40 48 40`, down `00 08 00 08`, down-left `38 40 48 40`, left `20 28 30 28`, up-left `50 58 60 58`, up `10 18 10 18`, up-right `50 58 60 58`.** RUN: all eight directions gave exactly those tile bases, a new pose every 8 frames.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): walking picture: metasprite
THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): walking picture: palette
regions.description: `$0560` := `$8F33[Y]`: the horizontal flip `$40` for right, down-right and up-right, none for the left side; down and up flip on the last two poses (`00 00 40 40`).

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: Zero the speed (`$8FAA`)
THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): move
regions.description: `JSR $C006` with the inline bytes `06 08 80`: a far call to bank 6 `$8009` (the wall-sliding move `$826D`).

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): the cell class changed?
regions.description: `$6C` (the class of the diagonal cell the move found) is compared with the last class `$07A0` and stored there. Unchanged goes to the sphere test (`$9015`).

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): changed: warp panel?
regions.description: Class 2 (the warp panel) only.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): warp: which exit
regions.description: y under `$38` -> exit 0 (north); y of `$90` or more -> 8 (south); otherwise x under `$30` -> 2 (west), else 6 (east): the exit the ship is nearest.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): warp: remember it
regions.description: `$A4` := the exit.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): warp: the key of that exit
regions.description: The exit number becomes 0-3 (N, W, E, S) and `$0058[...]` AND 7 is the door's key (set by the room loader); 0 needs none.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): warp: owned?
regions.description: key - 1 -> `JSR $C078` (`$EFC7`, the bit mask) -> AND `$04B0` (the keys held): not owned returns.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): warp: go
regions.description: `$A0` |= 3 (a warp-style exit: see the transition dispatcher) and sound `$3B`.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): the energy sphere?
regions.description: Class 1 under the ship (checked every frame, not only on a change).

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): sphere: pick-up
regions.description: Sound `$33`, chips +20 (`LDA #$14 / JSR $C12F`), life +2 (`LDA #$02 / JSR $C00C`).

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): sphere: remove it
regions.description: `$15` = `$17` := 0, `$16` := `$1C` (the floor tile), `$18:$19` := the foot position; `JMP $C11A` (the cell becomes class 0, `$FADE`).

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): room edges: north
regions.description: y under `$10`...

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): north: open?
regions.description: `$54` bit 7 and the north door byte `$58` low nibble 8 (no door) leave the room (`$9060`); otherwise y := `$10`.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): south edge
regions.description: y of `$B0` or more: `$54` bit 4 and `$5B` low nibble 8 -> leave (`$907E`: `$A4` := 8); otherwise y := `$AF`.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): west edge
regions.description: x under `$0E`: `$54` bit 6 and `$59` low nibble 8 -> leave (`$A4` := 2); otherwise x := `$0E`.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): east edge
regions.description: x of `$F2` or more: `$54` bit 5 and `$5A` low nibble 8 -> leave (`$A4` := 6); otherwise x := `$F1`. **The exits are 0 north, 2 west, 6 east, 8 south.** RUN: north left at y 15 (`$A4` = 0), south at 176 (8), east at 243 (6); the west wall of the room stopped the ship at x 16 before the edge test.

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): leave: ask for a room change
regions.description: `$A4` := the exit, `$A0` |= 1 (the transition dispatcher acts on it at the next stage step).

regions.name: THE PLAYER'S SHIP, labyrinth part (bank 3): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): first frame?
regions.description: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): bank 6 `$8475` (type 4) reaches it through bank 3 slot `$8006`. The type is set by the damage routine to the death type `$84` (`$D442`).

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): phase
regions.description: `LDA #$10 / LDY #$0A / JSR $C0A5`: ten phases of 16 frames = 160 frames.

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): wrapped
regions.description: At the wrap the type becomes 0: the slot is freed. (The GAME OVER decision is in bank 6 `$8232`.)

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): picture index
regions.description: `$15` := ($41 AND 1) + the phase.

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): pieces
regions.description: Y := 6 (7 pieces); while the phase is under 4 the ship itself is still drawn (`JSR $C090`) and Y := 5.

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): the piece loop
THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): a piece's x
THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): a piece's y
regions.description: `$84` := y + `$9128[Y]` (`F4 F4 00 00 0C 0C 00`: -12, -12, 0, 0, +12, +12, 0): a ring of six around the ship and one on it.

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): a piece's flip
regions.description: `$86` := ($41 + piece) AND 1: they flicker.

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): a piece's picture
regions.description: Metasprite `$912F[$15]` (`00 30 00 31 30 31 32 33 32 33`) through `$C093`: nothing, then the explosion pictures `$30`-`$33` as the phase grows.

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): next piece
regions.description: `DEC $14 / LDY $14 / BPL`.

regions.name: THE DYING SHIP (type 4, bank 3 slot `$8006`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: Dying ship: piece x offsets
Dying ship: piece y offsets
Dying ship: piece metasprite by index
